record_scope_reconstruction: National DRC international-departure health eligibility policy for exposure-defined cohorts, with distinct June 24 and July 17 regimes. Neither is a uniform all-passenger closure or an instruction identifying a finite set of border posts.

source_checks.finding: Third-party-hosted original decree OCR inspected. Articles 2–4 distinguish contacts, response personnel and others who had been in affected provinces; authorization exceptions differ. National land/river/air controls do not identify particular posts or establish physical closure.

Contemporaneous full relevant July 25 report describes July 17 replacement with individual A/B/C assessment. Only A is restricted/isolation subject to stated exception; B/C movement is conditional. No named land posts or uniform border closure established.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Modal scope: wider_border. June 24–July 17 cohort-specific international departure eligibility. Hold physical geography: affected province residence is a personal eligibility test, not the geographical extent of a frontier blockade.
unresolved: No land-post implementation or bounded physical restriction extent established.
No automatic use of all DRC adjacent borders or affected-province outlines.
